sentences.text:
Balram Manjhi Aged About 23 Years R/o Village-  Kodobhata, P.S.- Chandahandi, Dist.-Nabarangpur, Odisha.
 ------Applicant
VERSUS  State of Chhattisgarh through Station House Officer, Police Station -  Devbog, District - Gariyaband, Chhattisgarh
For Applicant : Mr. Yogesh Pandey, Advocate
For State : Mr. Rishabh Chandra Singh Deo, Panel Lawyer
Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge

Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 250/2023 registered at Police Station -Devbhog,
District Gariyaband (C.G.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366/34, 376(2)(n)(3) of IPC and Section 6, 4(2) of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that first bail application filed by the applicant was dismissed for want of prosecution.
He submits that applicant was examined before the trial court and there is omission and contradiction in the statement.

Applicant is in jail since since 19.08.2023,
hence, he may be released on regular bail.

3. Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and would submit that the age of victim on the date of incident was 14 years and 8 months and there are specific allegations in the statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 of CrPC as also the court's statement that the applicant has committed sexual intercourse.

sentences.text: 4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

5. Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:18920 nature of allegation, age of victim to be less than 15 years, I do not find present to be a fit case to allow this application.
6. Accordingly, this application filed under Section 439 of CrPC is rejected.

Sd/-
(Parth Prateem Sahu) Judge /pwn Rikhiram Manjhi vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75956719/
